evidence_summary: Same human clone recognizes DRB5-BALF5 and DRB1-MBP; both pMHC structures resolved.
Same human TCR recognizes DR15-MBP and processed bacterial EngA; both ternary structures resolved.
Same human TCR recognizes DQ1-MBP, HSV UL15, and Pseudomonas PMM; all three ternary structures resolved.
Human cross-reactive clone evidence, but exact paired peptides, registers, and structures are unresolved.
